summary: Frontend retest of the /app/kali fixes from iteration 64, logged in as student, using Playwright on the public URL. Every requested item passed. vi: new file with :w then :q keeps the content. :w then :q! keeps it too. :w, then more edits, then :q gives E37, and :q! after that keeps only the saved text. On an existing file, editing then :w and :q keeps the new content, and :q! without saving leaves it unchanged. :q! on a new file creates no file. :wq works. All files are still there after a reload. nano: ^O then ^X saves. Opening an existing file loads its content, and ^X with no changes keeps it. ^X on a new file with no changes creates no file. lx-users after a reset: `id` completes only task 0. `sudo userdel -r analyst2` before the user exists prints 'does not exist' and completes nothing. `groups` completes task 1. After useradd without sudo, sudo useradd -m, sudo passwd and sudo userdel -r, the lab reaches 6/6. Hint and solution boxes opened in lx-users do not show in lx-services, and they are closed again when you go back. Regression checks passed: clicking a lab right after the page loads opens the right lab, and the first PUT went to lx-users. The list counter shows 6/6 after a reload. Sandbox loops, pipes and tr work. Reset clears the tasks.

ui_bugs.issue: Saved files have no trailing newline. Real vi/nano add one, so `cat a b` runs the contents together on one line, e.g. 'alpha_saved_v2bravo_saved'. Cosmetic only.

issues: The title still shows 'kali@lab-phish-ransom — bash' whatever lab is open. This optional item is carried over from iteration 63/64.

action_items: Optional: add a trailing newline when vi/nano save a file that doesn't end in one
Optional: show the current lab id in the terminal title
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx: the `saved` ref fixes the bug. In vi, :q! closes with null when saved.current === initial, so nothing is written. This is correct.
Editor nano ^X saves without asking when there are unsaved changes. Real nano asks 'Save modified buffer?'. This is acceptable for a simulator but differs from real nano.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6 of 6 requested items pass; vi 7/7, nano 3/3, lx-users 8/8 steps)

seed_data_creation: None left behind. I backed up the student's (b9cafa42b8ca) sandbox kali_state doc with mongoexport and restored it exactly; the md5 matches. I deleted the lx-users doc the test created. No lx-services doc was created.
